scores.tell: Crystal ball glass is a bit too uniformly glossy with one big hard highlight; gold stand smooth. Wood tabletop grain is fine and plausible.
Layered map has uniformly soft, matte clay-like surfaces with a few glossy water highlights; very clean, almost no fine texture, but close to the real smooth style.
Hat is one flat matte clay-like felt with no stitching, grain or felt fiber; only the red band and star badge vary. Reads too uniform and plasticky.
Gold candelabra is uniformly metallic-gloss with soft gradients and a slight glow haze. Candle wax drips are smooth; little matte/shine contrast.
Pumpkin is evenly waxy glossy with no skin texture. Wood table planks are smooth and fine, which fits. Stem is a bit plasticky.
Foliage is busy with many small repeated leaf marks, and the brick edge and path have painterly noise. This is too texture-heavy and illustrative compared with the smooth real cards.
Stage light has crisp painted metal with a mix of matte body and shiny lens. Truss highlights are controlled. Matches the real cards closely.
Fabric seat and back are flat green with fine stitching, but they look slightly plastic. Metal tubes are uniformly chrome-gloss with ball joints.
Cap is an all-over glossy lacquer: white crown and navy visor have large soft highlights and read as plastic, not cloth. Wood planks have bold, decorative grain.
Rover body is smooth glossy orange plastic with little wear or fine detail. Small pebbles and dirt speckles are noisy. Tires and metal are soft and blobby.
